   - value '1'   -> matcher receives 1 (number) (test expects the string '1')

This test was evidently written against an older jest-dom whose toHaveValue returned the raw string value for number inputs; the dependency update to 7.0.1 made the locked assertions unsatisfiable. The only remaining "fix" would be DOM property surgery in the component to deceive the matcher, which contradicts the surrounding code style and would break if the expectation is corrected — deliberately not doing that.
